summarize_constants: summarize the minitaur robot constants module that defines URDF paths, joint names, and initial positions
review_JOINT_NAMES: review the JOINT_NAMES tuple that lists all 8 motor joint names for the minitaur quadruped robot
review_INIT_JOINT_ANGLES: review the INIT_JOINT_ANGLES OrderedDict mapping each joint name to its initial angle of pi/2
review_JOINT_DIRECTIONS: review the JOINT_DIRECTIONS mapping used to convert robot SDK joint angles to URDF joint angles
review_gin_constants: review the gin.constant registrations that expose minitaur constants for config binding
